The return for each cryptocurrency in the specified set is calculated independently over the given time period using the formula: Return = (Ending Price − Starting Price) / Starting Price × 100. The Starting Price and Ending Price are defined as the time-weighted average of the Spot Rate values published by CFBenchmarks during the 60-second intervals immediately preceding the start and end of the time period, respectively. Final returns are calculated on an identical basis for every cryptocurrency in the set and rounded to three decimal places (as a percentage).

If two or more cryptocurrencies report an identical return (rounded to three decimal places) such that they are tied for the highest
position, each tied cryptocurrency's Contract will resolve to "Yes" with a value equal to $1 divided by the number of cryptocurrencies tied for the highest position,
rounded down to the nearest cent, and each remaining (non-tied) cryptocurrency's
Contract will resolve to "No."
KXCRYPTOLEAD15M-26OCT212145-BTC.title: Which of these cryptocurrencies will have the highest return from Oct 21 - 9:30PM EDT to 9:45PM EDT?

KXEOWEEK-26OCT10-4.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if complete Federal Register data becomes available.
KXEOWEEK-26OCT10-4.rules_primary: If the President signs above 4 executive orders during Oct 4, 2026 to Oct 10, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXEOWEEK-26OCT10-4.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The signing date as recorded in the Federal Register determines which period an Executive Order belongs to.
For example, if the period was "Jan 1, 2025 to Jan 7, 2025," and on January 10th the Federal Register published a numbered Executive Order with a January 7th signing date, the market would resolve to Yes.

Payout criteria

An "Executive Order" is a numbered presidential directive that: is formally titled "Executive Order" followed by a number, is signed by the President, is published in the Federal Register, and has the force of law.
All documents officially designated as "Executive Orders" with sequential numbering count, including Executive Orders that are later revoked or amended.

Expiration date

The latest Expiration Date of the Contract shall be two weeks after the end of the period.
If an Executive Order that is dated past Oct 4, 2026 to Oct 10, 2026 is posted to the Federal Register, expiration may be moved to an earlier date.
KXEOWEEK-26OCT10-4.title: Will the President sign more than 4 Executive Orders between Oct 4, 2026 and Oct 10, 2026?

KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT21-BESS.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT21-BESS.rules_primary:
If 
 Donald Trump says Bessent as part of Midterm Rally in Clemson, South Carolina originally scheduled for October 21, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT21-BESS.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Midterm Rally in Clemson, South Carolina originally scheduled for October 21, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Midterm Rally in Clemson, South Carolina originally scheduled for October 21, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.
KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT21-BESS.title: What will Donald Trump say during Midterm Rally in Clemson, South Carolina originally scheduled for October 21, 2026?

KXEOWEEK-26OCT10-2.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if complete Federal Register data becomes available.
KXEOWEEK-26OCT10-2.rules_primary: If the President signs above 2 executive orders during Oct 4, 2026 to Oct 10, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXEOWEEK-26OCT10-2.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The signing date as recorded in the Federal Register determines which period an Executive Order belongs to.
For example, if the period was "Jan 1, 2025 to Jan 7, 2025," and on January 10th the Federal Register published a numbered Executive Order with a January 7th signing date, the market would resolve to Yes.

Payout criteria

An "Executive Order" is a numbered presidential directive that: is formally titled "Executive Order" followed by a number, is signed by the President, is published in the Federal Register, and has the force of law.
All documents officially designated as "Executive Orders" with sequential numbering count, including Executive Orders that are later revoked or amended.

Expiration date

The latest Expiration Date of the Contract shall be two weeks after the end of the period.
If an Executive Order that is dated past Oct 4, 2026 to Oct 10, 2026 is posted to the Federal Register, expiration may be moved to an earlier date.
KXEOWEEK-26OCT10-2.title: Will the President sign more than 2 Executive Orders between Oct 4, 2026 and Oct 10, 2026?

KXTRUMPACT-26OCT18-T12.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken at least 12 presidential actions from Oct 18, 2026 through Oct 24, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 25, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPACT-26OCT18-T12.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication dates visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 25, 2026.
The week runs from Oct 18, 2026 through Oct 24, 2026.

Payout criteria

The actions may include proclamations, executive orders, nominations & appointments, and memoranda.
Any item listed on the page counts, regardless of its legal effect.

Examples (for Jan 10, 2026):

Executive Order with a Jan 7 signing date is released with a Jan 10 publication date → resolves Yes
Proclamation e-mailed to White House Press Pool but not uploaded by 10:00 AM next day → resolves No
Proclamation is released Jan 10 with a backdated Jan 9 publication date → resolves No
Bill signed into law and shows up on "Briefings & Statements" instead of "Presidential Actions" → resolves No
KXTRUMPACT-26OCT18-T12.title: Will there be at least 12 presidential actions in the week of Oct 18, 2026?

KXEOWEEK-26OCT17-3.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if complete Federal Register data becomes available.
KXEOWEEK-26OCT17-3.rules_primary: If the President signs above 3 executive orders during Oct 11, 2026 to Oct 17, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXEOWEEK-26OCT17-3.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The signing date as recorded in the Federal Register determines which period an Executive Order belongs to.
For example, if the period was "Jan 1, 2025 to Jan 7, 2025," and on January 10th the Federal Register published a numbered Executive Order with a January 7th signing date, the market would resolve to Yes.

Payout criteria

An "Executive Order" is a numbered presidential directive that: is formally titled "Executive Order" followed by a number, is signed by the President, is published in the Federal Register, and has the force of law.
All documents officially designated as "Executive Orders" with sequential numbering count, including Executive Orders that are later revoked or amended.

Expiration date

The latest Expiration Date of the Contract shall be two weeks after the end of the period.
If an Executive Order that is dated past Oct 11, 2026 to Oct 17, 2026 is posted to the Federal Register, expiration may be moved to an earlier date.
KXEOWEEK-26OCT17-3.title: Will the President sign more than 3 Executive Orders between Oct 11, 2026 and Oct 17, 2026?

KXTRUMPENDORSEMENTS-26OCT23-A20.rules_primary: If Donald Trump endorses at least 20 people for their election on Truth Social from Oct 17, 2026 through Oct 23, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPENDORSEMENTS-26OCT23-A20.rules_secondary:
Any formal endorsement will qualify, including reaffirmations of prior endorsements. If Trump endorses multiple people in an election, all will be counted towards the total. The endorsement must be a clear, affirmative statement of support. Ambiguous statements of support will not qualify. Conditional endorsements will qualify. A person cannot be counted more than once in a given week. 

Examples:
Donald Trump states "I endorse [candidate] for [office]"
Donald Trump states "I support [candidate]" referencing a political race
Donald Trump states "Vote for [candidate]" publicly
Donald Trump states "[candidate] has my full support" for [race]

Examples that would NOT count:
Trump posts a graphic that says "[Candidate] wins" that merely states as fact they were endorsed by President Trump
KXTRUMPENDORSEMENTS-26OCT23-A20.title: Will Trump endorse at least 20 people on Truth Social this week?

KXONIONACT-30JAN01-30JAN01.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXONIONACT-30JAN01-30JAN01.rules_primary: If the Onion Futures Act has been completely repealed after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXONIONACT-30JAN01-30JAN01.rules_secondary:
For this market, complete repeal requires a bill to become law eliminating both prohibitions in 7 U.S.C. section 13-1(a):

futures trading in onions
futures trading in motion-picture box-office receipts, including any related index, measure, value or data

Repealing only one prohibition does not qualify. The repeal may be standalone, an amendment, or part of a larger bill.

Enactment counts even if the repeal takes effect later.
KXONIONACT-30JAN01-30JAN01.title: Will the Onion Futures Act be repealed before Jan 1, 2030?

KXONIONACT-30JAN01-27JAN01.rules_secondary:
For this market, complete repeal requires a bill to become law eliminating both prohibitions in 7 U.S.C. section 13-1(a):

futures trading in onions
futures trading in motion-picture box-office receipts, including any related index, measure, value or data

Repealing only one prohibition does not qualify. The repeal may be standalone, an amendment, or part of a larger bill.

Enactment counts even if the repeal takes effect later.
KXONIONACT-30JAN01-27JAN01.title: Will the Onion Futures Act be repealed before Jan 1, 2027?

KXTRUMPPHOTO-26OCT25-7.rules_primary: If the number of distinct days Donald Trump is photographed in a tagged editorial photo on Getty Images between Oct 19, 2026 and Oct 25, 2026 is exactly 7, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPPHOTO-26OCT25-7.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

If a tagged photo does not actually depict Donald Trump, or is materially mis-tagged (for example, with the wrong date), Kalshi reserves the right to disregard that photo when resolving the market.
Conversely, if a photo is correctly tagged as depicting Donald Trump but its metadata date does not reflect the actual date the photo was taken (in local time), Kalshi reserves the right to include that photo based on the actual date.

Past examples with no qualifying photos: April 4, 2026
KXTRUMPPHOTO-26OCT25-7.title: Will the number of distinct days with a Getty Images editorial photo of Trump be exactly 7 between Oct 19, 2026 and Oct 25, 2026?

KXRAINONT-27FEB27-27FEB27-T0.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at Ontario International Airport (KONT) in Ontario, California in the Feb 27, 2027 reporting day is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXRAINONT-27FEB27-27FEB27-T0.rules_secondary:
This daily market uses The Weather Company's precipitation total for Ontario International Airport (KONT), California, for the reporting day dated February 27, 2027. Data is available at https://weather.com/kalshi under Domestic, Daily Climate, Ontario (ONT). The market resolves Yes if total precipitation is strictly greater than 0.00 inches.

Total precipitation includes liquid-equivalent rainfall and melted frozen precipitation. Trace amounts and missing daily values count as 0.00 inches, subject to the contract's data-error and contingency provisions. Forecasts do not count. Use the initial non-preliminary reported value, subject to the contract's material-error correction provisions. A Final label alone does not establish that the data is error-free. If no reliable data is available by expiration, the contract's last-fair-price provision applies.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Weather Company. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.
KXRAINONT-27FEB27-27FEB27-T0.title: Will it rain in Ontario, California on Feb 27, 2027?
